items.title: The thumbless Slider, with each lettered point placed (joins the owner's thumbless order)
items.dedupe_of: O-408 (which supersedes O-406); LF-18 sits beside it in 11.3.0 (hassio-r13/PLACED.md:22). (a) and the squeeze in (b) are the open remainder of O-280/O-283's geometry row, booked in 11.1.2 (glass-11.1.1-scope.md:73).
items.evidence: Master, src/components/slider/styles.css. (a)/(b): the held rule at :295-304 (vertical :409-417) scales the fill by (1.02 + 0.16·smear, 0.94 − 0.06·smear) from the fill's start (:26, :57-64). That breaks the lane law at :174-182: the fill's painted end is meant to be the thumb's far edge less 0.25 px (`--slider-cap-reach`, :197-219). useDragVelocity caps the smear at 0.7, times `--motion-weight` 0.618 (:290-297), so the x scale reaches about 1.089: 6 to 27 px ahead on a 300 px fill and about 62 px on 700 px, which matches the 10 to 70 px measured. The 0.94 term is the squeeze, and the reduced-motion leg (:322-328, :423-428) still squeezes 0.97. The height-and-radius half of the O-280/O-283 cure already shipped in 11.0.2 (0e3cbfb3d, a671920c6; both in v11.0.2 and v11.1.0). bl/slider/proto 87b3d259c ('geometry cure, one height, one radius, no press deform') is the rest: it deletes both held transforms. fcea8de25 and fe30f9882 add `expand` (a shell that grows by clip-path inside a fixed band). On release/11.1.1 the only Slider change is fb43904d7 (reduced-motion clocks; `git log v11.1.0..release/11.1.1 -- src/components/slider`). (c) `--slider-touch-target: 1.5rem` (tokens/sizing.css:298-305), described there as deliberately the 24 px floor and not 44, is read at slider/styles.css:124-133; `--touch-target` is 2.75rem (sizing.css:296). (d) the spectrum ring is at styles.css:368-377. (e) the root has `touch-action: none` (styles.css:31). useTouchGate is exported (src/composables/dom/useTouchGate.ts:54-60, src/index.ts:452), but Slider.vue does not import it (:12-24). (f) one `step` (types.ts:22) goes through to reka (Slider.vue:47-64). (g) `marks` already ships (types.ts:27-28, Slider.vue:435-448, styles.css:183-204), and there is no origin prop. (h) `--slider-thumb-bg` is public (styles.css:244-253). Frames read: timeline-fourier-phone-today-vs-thumbless ('today, held': the fill runs past the dot), slider-390-detail and p1-color-p390-dark. glass-extras-today.png was not opened (privacy).
items.row: The thumbless default is a changed default look that the owner ordered (O-408). It is neither dock nor Metric work, so it goes in 11.3.0. (a) GLASS DEFECT, 11.1.2, as the open remainder of scope:73 (11.0.2 took the height and radius; the press deform is what is left of W-B.18's geometry cure). Take 87b3d259c's no-press-deform hunk: no held transform, in either orientation or under reduced motion. Witness: on every held frame of a fast drag, the fill's far end lies within 0.5 px of the thumb's far edge less 0.25 px, in both engines, RED on v11.1.0. (The lane comment's word 'trailing' names the range before its cap reach, so the witness reads the far edge.) It sits beside O-359's 'thumb centre on the press point' (scope:105). (b) The squeeze leaves with (a), since it breaks the one-height law 11.0.2 published. Growth inside a fixed band is fe30f9882's `expand`, a new prop: 11.3.0. (c) 11.3.0: `--slider-touch-target` defaults to 2.75rem on coarse pointers. This changes a token's value and grows every slider's root on touch. Sites can set it now. (d) OWNER QUESTION (study §7 Q4). The default offered: the spectrum keeps today's ring. If he takes the thin line, it is P1's B seam with an answer for both ends, in 11.3.0. (e) 11.3.0, a changed default built on useTouchGate: a vertical start scrolls the page, and a horizontal start or a tap takes the slider. O-407's wider gate for scrolling regions stays a later design question. (f) 11.3.0: a new prop for drag resolution, apart from the key step. (g) Ticks are already cured (`marks`). A neutral origin is a new prop in 11.3.0. (h) Answered yes on 11-19 (INBOUND O-414). Flag for the orchestrator: scope:86 books 'the Slider's fill takes the accent by default' in 11.1.2. By this release rule that is a changed default look, so it belongs in a minor (11.3.0 with this row). It is not moved here, but it should be restated.
items.reply: In 11.1.2 glass stops stretching and squeezing a held fill, so its end stays under your finger. 11.3.0 brings the thumbless form, with growth inside a fixed band, a 44 px touch band by default, vertical swipes that scroll the page, a key step set apart from drag resolution, and a neutral origin. Ticks already ship as `marks`. The thin line for colour ramps waits on the owner's call. You can set `--slider-thumb-bg` to your fill colour and `--slider-touch-target: 2.75rem` today.

items.title: The fold draws the folded face over seats that still show; late first frame; no fold after a menu's release
items.dedupe_of: The dock redesign's fold gate (W-I.8 G-2, the clock bite on G-2, and G-1 (i)), with K09 and E already routed there. The late first frame is also O-361 L3 (one rule for every script spring), booked in 11.1.2 (glass-11.1.1-scope.md:108; INBOUND:343).
items.evidence: Master: morph.css:233-247 keys the folded face's reveal to `--dock-morph-t`, a front-loaded single glyph with onset 0. The run's seats fade on `--dock-expand-t`, so the face reaches full strength while the seats under it still paint. The fourier strip E-app-dock-fold-pointer-1440 (read) shows the ℱ over 'Paper' in rows 3 to 7. motion-dock-today row 1 (read) shows the stage column's '…' over the eye seat while the pencil seat slides through fading seats. Redesign: W-I.8.md:92 gives R-3's two windows and :95 says 'never two things at strength'; :352 is OQ-9, default 'out, then in'. W-I.8.md:282: G-2 requires content to be 'visible until covered', and its bite 'the loop's clock started at the trigger' covers the late first frame. W-I.8.md:281: G-1 (i) requires one linger and one fold after `release()` with the pointer outside; master is RED there ('800 ms and then a second window'). RULINGS-7.md:548: an overlay opened from a seat holds the dock with nothing to wire. MEASURE-8.md:51: G-2 is 110 of 110 in both engines on the build's rows. The clock half: the master dock's fold is a script spring (useDockMorph.ts:94 calls useDockSpring, which builds a keyframes.js SpringProgress at useDockSpring.ts:95). fourier's inv-shell item 2 says it is 'clocked by wall time from the trigger' (first frame 32 to 185 ms late, then a 290.9 to 195 px step at 4x). O-361 L3 books 'a spring's clock starts on its first painted frame ... one rule for every script spring' for 11.1.2, with the Sheet as its RED.
items.row: The face over the seats and the missed fold after a release are in the 11.2.0 redesign. The face fault is the shipped carrier's front-loaded summary reveal (morph.css:244-246), which R-3's out-then-in windows replace. The missed fold after a release is G-1 (i), plus the overlay hold that retires keepOpen/release. The late first frame is already a patch row: O-361 L3 in 11.1.2 states the rule for every script spring. The 11.1.2 seat should add the dock's fold as a second witness cell: a tap-outside fold at 390 under 4x throttle, no step over the spring's own between the first two painted frames, RED on v11.1.0. G-2's clock bite keeps it in 11.2.0. fourier's three strips can serve as reference cells beside G-2's fourier canvas-dock cell.
items.reply: From 11.1.2 every glass spring, the dock's fold among them, starts its clock on the first frame it paints, so a slow phone no longer sees the fold jump. In the 11.2.0 dock redesign the folded face arrives only after the seats under it have gone. A menu opened from a seat then holds the dock by itself, and the dock folds one pause after the menu closes, so your keepOpen and release calls can go.

items.title: A change of seats on an open dock lands in one frame (the contextual top bar)
items.dedupe_of: O-411 (the contextual top bar), built as the redesign's seat-set gate (W-I.8 G-4); C-25, D-06 and F-41's width are routed there too
items.evidence: Master: useDockMorph.ts:106-122 arms the morph only when the active layer changes (folded to open or back). Seats added or removed inside the open face therefore re-lay the plate at its new width with no tween. motion-dock-today (read) shows this: row 2 is fourier's 136 px jump between 759 and 932 ms, row 3 is daraksha's two rows showing together at 46 to 114 ms, and row 5 is color's two faces at +79 ms. Redesign: W-I.8.md:284. G-4 covers a seat added or removed by glass or by a consumer's v-if, and a route that changes the seat set. Its clauses: plate edges stay inside the spring bounds, the two faces are never both above 0.5, and every fade passes. MEASURE-8.md:51: G-4 is 43 of 43 in both engines. MEASURE-8.md:79: a joining seat steps 0.28 to 0.31 a frame, a leaving seat fades out in 82 to 89 ms, and the ghost plant bites.
items.row: Already built on bl/dock/wi8, landing in 11.2.0 with O-411. The site's half stays the site's: each page declares its seats so they are present from the route's first frame (fourier F-41's presence and order).
items.reply: In 11.2.0, when the seats of an open dock change, the dock's width glides and the old and new seats cross without both ever showing at full strength. A layer swap works the same way. fourier only needs to declare each page's seats so they are there from that page's first frame.

items.title: Dock density on touch: trigger height, short seats, the vertical dock's cross padding and its off-axis folded face
items.dedupe_of: (1) O-349 (3) in 11.1.2 (DockTrigger at the coarse-pointer minimum, glass-11.1.1-scope.md:95) and the trigger's seat height built on bl/dock/wi8 at 943fe6e9d. (2) O-298 in 11.1.2 (dock tab seats at the coarse-pointer minimum, scope:75) and RU-75 in 11.2.0. (4) scope:92 in 11.1.2: the folded vertical summary is narrower than its column (11.0.2 fix-4 D-2). The plate's padding and the glyph's share: O-409.
items.evidence: (1) Master triggers.css:31 has `min-height: var(--dock-trigger-min-height, auto)`. On a coarse pointer master already gives every dock trigger a 44 px hit-slop that paints nothing (controls/touch-floor.css:41-53), so the target is met and the painted trigger is 28 to 32 px. bl/dock/wi8 943fe6e9d (branch only, not on master or release/11.1.1) gives a trigger the seat height (triggers.css:62-69). Its selector is `.glass-dock .dock-run :is(...)`, and the run is the full layer (wi8 GlassDock.vue:604). A trigger in `#persistent` or `#persistent-end` (wi8 GlassDock.vue:556, :652) keeps `auto`. (2) keyframes' 30 to 32 px seats in a 60 px plate are two triggers and a worded seat (dock-open-390-detail, read). The tab seat's `min-height` falls to `auto` on master (controls/tab-button.css:26) with no coarse floor. That is RU-75 (RULINGS-7.md:171-176; step S5 at :439). (3) Master morph.css:142-155 pins a vertical dock's cross padding to `--dock-padding-inline`, 0.75rem (density.css:126-128). A row's cross axis takes `--dock-padding-block`, 0.5rem (morph.css:101-124, density.css:123-125). So a folded column is 68 px wide where a folded row is 60 px tall. The 'H/V PROPORTION PARITY' comment at shell.css:399-400 promises the same tokens, not the same geometry. wi8 keeps the rule (morph.css:146, shell.css:455). No ruling in W-I.8 or RULINGS-2 to 7 books it. (4) On master the folded face is a square of 0.85 × the layer height (morph.css:205-225, sizing.css:198, coarse density.css:392-394), placed at the start of a column whose persistent seat is 44 px: 37.4 px in 44, 3.3 px off the axis (fourier inv-shell 'For glass' item 3). The seat's claim that wi8 leaves this rule unchanged is WRONG: 943fe6e9d morph.css:204-234 rewrote it to `inline-size: max-content; min-inline-size: var(--dock-layer-height); padding-inline: 0.5rem` with no aspect-ratio. On the redesign the face is a seat wide, but its block size in a column stays 0.85 of the layer, because the layer-height floor at wi8 layers.css:198-201 is `:not(.vertical)`. Release-11.0.2 fix-4.md D-2 measured the same width mismatch (summary 34/37 against seats 40/44, the padding pinned at 12 px) and left it for 11.1.2 (scope:92).
items.row: (1) On touch, the target already holds through the hit-slop, and O-349 (3) in 11.1.2 reads what remains. The painted trigger at the seat height is 943fe6e9d's default in 11.2.0 for triggers in the run. The build seat either extends the selector to the persistent regions or the README says the default reaches the run only. (2) On touch, the tab seat's floor is O-298 in 11.1.2. A worded or labelled seat as tall as a seat at every pointer is RU-75 in 11.2.0. (3) A new row for the dock redesign's next ruling round: a vertical dock's cross axis takes the block pad. It changes the width of every vertical dock, so it is a look and a minor. It reaches 11.2.0 only if that round lands before the tag, and otherwise the minor after. (4) MOVED to 11.1.2 as an at-rest witness on scope:92's row, which has the same cause. Centre the folded face on the column's axis with no token or size change. Witness: the face's centre within 0.5 px of the persistent seat's centre on fourier's column composition at 390 coarse, both engines, RED on v11.1.0. The merge onto wi8 reconciles the hunk with the rewritten rule, and G-2's vertical cells read the redesign's face (a face a seat wide but 0.85 tall would be a new fault there). The plate's own padding and the glyph's share stay with O-409 and the owner's glyph-size question (study §7 Q1).
items.reply: 11.1.2 brings dock triggers and worded tab seats to the 44 px touch minimum and centres a folded vertical dock's face on its column. In 11.2.0 a trigger or worded seat in the dock's main row takes the seat's height by itself, so the per-site trigger hook can go there. Matching a vertical dock's side padding to a row's 8 px goes to the dock's next ruling. The plate's padding and the icon size wait on the owner's answer about glyph size.

items.title: Tabs inside a dock as a small pill outside the fold (fourier's Controls and Canvas)
items.dedupe_of: O-411 (segmented tabs inside a dock, booked with the dock redesign after its eighth pass, '11.2.0 or the round after')
items.evidence: Master has no dock form of tabs. SegmentedTabs shares only the dock's indicator spring (src/components/tabs/styles/segmented.css:28, :166-168). On a touch screen its strip is 50 px, a 44 px tab plus trim (11.1.0 raised the tab; release/11.1.1 segmented.css:74-80 keeps the round ends; CHANGELOG 11.1.1 'Fixed'), which is taller than a 44 px dock seat. DockLayerGroup switches the dock's own layers (DockLayerGroup.vue:36-37), not a view pair. The never-folding regions exist: `#persistent` at GlassDock.vue:486-507 and `#persistent-end` at :606-619. The seat's citation of GlassDock.vue:332-338 points at a focus comment, not the slots. INBOUND O-411 books 'segmented tabs inside a dock' after the eighth pass. RULINGS-7.md:445-463, the closed 11.2.0 ready list, does not carry it. Frame: phone-stage-today cells 1 to 4 (the 58 px switch band).
items.row: Already booked as O-411. It is a new dock part, so by the release rule it is a minor that belongs with the dock work: a segmented pair at seat height in the persistent region, outside the fold. It needs the next ruling round because the eighth pass's list is closed, so it reaches 11.2.0 only if that round lands before the tag. The choice between words and one toggle seat is fourier's, settled by the study's P4 film.
items.reply: A small segmented pair that sits in the dock outside the fold is booked with the 11.2.0 dock work, after its current build pass. Until it lands, the pair can stand as two seats in the dock's never-folding region, because a SegmentedTabs strip is taller than a dock seat on touch.

items.title: Escape does not fold a press-opened dock when focus is on the page
items.evidence: Master: GlassDock.vue:316-323 handles Escape only as a keydown on the open face (bound at :561). The dock directory has no document-level key listener; the only keydown listener is the run's (useDockRun.ts:447). A pointer press on the folded face moves no focus (useDockState.ts:600-608). The summary goes inert as the dock opens (GlassDock.vue:573), so focus falls to body. Only the keyboard path focuses the first seat (onSummaryKeydown, GlassDock.vue:276-281). A press-only focusout with no relatedTarget does not fold the dock (useDockState.ts:588). The contract says Escape closes an `expandOn="press"` dock: src/components/dock/README.md:58-60 (the dock's README, not the root one) and useDockShellProps.ts:94-99. release/11.1.1 does not touch GlassDock.vue or useDockState.ts. The redesign has the same gap: bl/dock/wi8 GlassDock.vue:360-371 (now with an `isHeld` gate) is bound at :611. fourier's StageDock uses `expand-on="press"` on glass 11.1.0 and adds no key handling (o41-inv-shell web/src/components/shared/StageDock.vue:94-99; package.json pins 11.1.0). fourier measured it 3 of 3. atlas's figure docks are also press docks (INBOUND O-275). No booked row: O-353 covers Escape inside a dock's Select, O-357 (1) covers Escape inside a seat's popover, and W-I.8 G-8 covers Escape with an overlay open.
items.row: A defect cure with no API or token change, scoped to `expandOn="press"` as the contract states. Extending it to a hover dock pinned by a click would change behaviour the contract does not promise. While such a dock is open, an Escape that no open dismissable layer on the page owns folds it wherever focus is. It uses a document listener armed only while the dock is open and keeps the open-layer gate and the consumer's keepOpen count. Focus stays on body. It joins O-353's dock-focus row in seat D. Witness: vitest plus one Chromium cell, RED on v11.1.0. A mouse press on the folded face leaves focus on body, and Escape then folds the dock. With a seat's menu open, the first Escape closes the menu and the second folds the dock. It carries into 11.2.0 by merge onto wi8's handler and its `isHeld` gate.
items.reply: In 11.1.2 glass will fold a dock opened with `expand-on="press"` when Escape is pressed while focus is on the page, after any open menu has taken its own Escape. Nothing needs to change on fourier's side.
